entries.description: Mit AutoBar erstellt ihr kleine Aktionsleisten zusätzlich zu euren normalen Actionbars. Je nach Konfiguration füllt sich die Leiste mit unterschiedlichen Gegenständen wie beispielsweise Gesundheitssteine, Manatränke, Questgegenstände und vieles mehr. Selbst Zaubersprüche, Schmuckstücke und Makros lassen sich auf die Zusatzleiste ziehen und werden automatich nach Bedarf abgeändert.

entries.description: Dieses AddOn startet automatisch beim Betreten einer Instanz oder eines Raids /combatlog und deaktiviert es automatisch, wenn man eben jene verlässt.

entries.description: This simple addon enlarges the Raid Information frame allowing you to see more of your raid lockouts and adds a checkbox next to each lockout. Checking the box will cause this addon to automatically extend the lockout every time you login.

entries.name: AutoHysteria

entries.description:
This addon remove (swap) your weapons automatically if you are melee and get mind controlled by a variety of bosses, like Lady Deathwhisper, and a lot more, like removing Paladin's RF buff if you are not a tank.

Configs are done via interface or slash commands like **/awr**.

entries.name: BasicBrokers

It supports default nameplates and most custom nameplate addons, and can share detection data with BattlegroundTargets. Use /bgh to open the configuration panel.

entries.name: BattlegroundTargets-WotLK
entries.description: Backported Addon for WoW 3.3.5a

BindPad is an addon to make KeyBindings for spells, items, and macros.
You no longer need actionbar slots just to make Key bindings for your macros etc.
BindPad addon provides many icon slots in its frame.  You can drag and drop
anything into one of these slots, and click the slot to set KeyBindings.

entries.name: BNetToast

entries.name: BNIsNotSelf

What it does is it announces in /yell when a player on the opposite team has less than a specified amount of Max HP (by default 25,000). By announcing this, you can easily tell what players are wearing PvE gear and kill them first.

entries.name: hAutoShot
entries.description: please accept my apology for abandoning this addon and not answering your support requests.

entries.name: HBarHide
entries.description: HBarHide • What does it do? It allows you to show or hide the default actionbars with just a simple click.

entries.name: Healbot
entries.description: A supportive addon for healers, as it can do numerous amounts of helpful little tricks.

entries.name: Healers Have To Die
entries.description: Healers Have to Die ist ausschließlich für PvP gedacht und markiert dir in einem Schlachtfeld jene Spieler, die eine heilende Aufgabe übernehmen mit einem roten, leicht erkennbaren "+".

entries.name: HealthPercents
entries.description: A simple mod to display the remaining health percentage of the target and/or focus target in a small moveable window.

entries.name: Hed's runes
entries.description: Shows Runes in columns of same color, RP and Diseases. Lua Config: local x=0 local y=0 local hrp=6 - RP H local hdes=8 - Diseases H local rsize=18 - Rune size local rspace=3 - Rune space

entries.name: Hellscream
entries.description: Hi everybody! This addon will play random sounds from a large list of bosses in the World of Warcraft whenever you cast things like Metamorphosis, Eye of Kilrogg, Detect invisibility, Fel domination or Army of the dead. Even when you gain the Decimation buff.

entries.name: Hermes-WotLK
entries.description: Backport of Hermes, an addon that tracks your raid's cooldowns, and displays them using configurable buttons or bars.

entries.name: hexeMap
entries.description: This is the minimap addon I wrote to go with my own personal UI.

entries.name: HiddenRaidNames
entries.description: Turns off the display of friendly player names when in a raid zone. Nothing less, nothing more.

entries.name: Hide The Watch Frame
entries.description: Adds a button to hide the quest/achievement watch frame even if you are tracking quests/ Achievements, without having to unwatch each specific quest/achievement.

entries.name: HideCinematics
entries.description: Simple add-on that will block the UI from automatically playing in-game cinematics (such as the one that is played every time you defeat the lich king).

entries.name: HidingBar
entries.description: Auto-hiding action bar that slides in/out on hover

entries.name: HitsLikeATruck
entries.description: A simple addon that play a sound file whenever you die. The addon makes it less depressing do die - makes it quite fun to die actually! You can also change the sound file if you like to, but it wont be better than the one already there though..

entries.name: HoloFriends
entries.description: Dieses AddOn modifiziert das Freundfenster von WoW, um ein besseres Management der Freundes- und Ignorierenliste zu ermöglichen.

entries.name: Horn of Winter
entries.description: What it does: This addon will display a large warning text and make a distinct sound when the "Horn of Winter" buff fades. The sound and text can be customized through slash commands. Good for raids to remind you to keep up the buff!

entries.name: HP & Mana Percents
entries.description: Addon that shows the percents of HP & Mana next to the unitframe. Made as a comission to my guildmate.

entries.name: hud
entries.description: hud Configuration can be accessed with /hud Most things should work now exept changing animations on health and power bar, left and right block and settings for runes/cp.

entries.name: Hydrogen
entries.description: Hydrogen ist another lifetime and castbar display for the Water Elemental (and other pets).

entries.name: I Hear NPC People
entries.description: What is this? Are you visually impaired, and because of that (or for some other reason) do you have trouble reading in-game gossip & quest dialogues? This mod concept is designed to help you. The idea is that when you're presented with text, it'll be read out to you from an audio file.

entries.name: I'd Check That!
entries.description: This is an addon I made for my guild's officers, because they wanted a flask/food check addon like Big Brother, without all the extra stuff. Defaulted channel can be changed in the lua, but it only defaults on reloads. Last known option is generally used if none has been specified. :)

entries.name: Ice Stone
entries.description: Ice Stone - Aiur "...best mod ever."-KnThrak Introduction Do you miss seeing "The Ice Stone has melted!"? Ever want to bring it back? Ice Stone will randomly output the Ice Stone's message at a minimum of once every 5 minutes.

entries.name: IceHUD
entries.description: IceHUD ist eine der beliebtesten HUD-Mods. Kurvenförmige Balken direkt neben dem Charakter ersetzen die normalen Unitframes für Spieler und Ziel. Lebenspunkte, Mana und sogar die Zauberleiste werden in verschiedenen Layouts direkt in der Mitte des Bildschirms angezeigt, um Euch den Blick zu den Spielerportrait oben rechts zu ersparen.

entries.name: Iconic - Simple Macro Icon Search
entries.description: What it does Iconic integrates into Blizzard's default Macro UI. There are no slash commands, no setup, and no preferences to mess with.

entries.name: IDs
entries.description: IDs zeigt in Tooltips die IDs von NPCs, Items, Spells etc. sowie GUIDs von Spielern und Pets an.

entries.name: Ignore Announce
entries.description: Announces when an ignored player joins your party http://forums.wow-europe.com/thread.html?topicId=14713231561

entries.name: IgnoreMore
entries.description: IgnoreMore will let you ignore more than 49 players, share the same ignore list, see when someone was ignored, reason for why the person is ignored

entries.name: iGratz Ding Mod
entries.description: This is a mod to the addon iGratz. You need iGratz in order to use this mod.

entries.name: iGratz Zip Archive
entries.description: Some people have asked for a zip upload of the addon so here it is. I will keep this page updated with zip's of the releases.

entries.name: Immersion
entries.description: Immersion is a replacement for the dated quest & gossip frames.

entries.name: impMotD (improved Message of the Day)
entries.description: Description Displays current MotD of your guild in a seperate box at the center of the screen. In addition to this it will also pop-up if the MotD is updated.

entries.name: Improved Profession Capper
entries.description:
Profession Capper is a addon that will show you how to level up your trade skills.

When you open your Profession frame, the Profession Capper frame will be opened too, telling you which recipe you'd better to craft next in order to reach next level of that profession.

entries.name: Informant
entries.description: Adds vendor price, use info, and extended details to item tooltips

entries.name: Inline Aura
entries.description: Inline Aura zeigt die verbleibende Laufzeit und Anzahl aufgetragener Stacks von Buffs und Debuffs auf den zugehörigen Buttons der Action Bars an.

entries.name: InspectEquip
entries.description:
InspectEquip attaches a panel to the inspect window that shows a list of the character's equipment sorted by source (i.e. Raid, Vendor, Crafted...).

This gives you a quick overview of a character's equipment.

entries.name: Instance Loot
entries.description: Instance Loot zeigt euch, ähnlich wie AtlasLoot, den Loot von Instanzen und Raids an.

entries.name: Instance-Spell-Collector-WotLK
entries.description: Collect debuffs and enemy casts!

entries.name: InterruptBar
entries.description: A addon that tracks enemy interrupt abilities on a neat little bar.

entries.name: inTiller Defile
entries.description: InTiller Defile is an Arthas Boss Mod to announce Defile on raid channel. It is very light-weight because there is no options (less than 2kb). Please give comments !

entries.name: iRaid
entries.description: iRaid This small addon shows a simple text with some information about your raid. I made it because I am a DD and don't need big raid-frames. When you are not in a raid the text is hidden.

entries.name: iTargetingFrames
entries.description:
Displays nameplate units in a clickable grid.
Requires a patched client with AwesomeWotlk (https://github.com/FrostAtom/awesome_wotlk).
If units are shown more than once, you need the modified DLL-file with fixed nameplate units from this repository.
**Does not work on servers that do not support AwesomeWotLK features (e.g. Warmane).**
Does not work on servers that do not support AwesomeWotLK features (e.g. Warmane).

entries.name: ItemLevel-WotLK
entries.description: WoW 3.3.5a Addon

entries.name: ItemLink
entries.description: I wrote this addon up after fruitlessly searching for a small, light-weight tool that could do something extremely basic: searching and presenting a list of items based on a partial item name or item ID.

entries.name: ItemLinkMacros
entries.description: ItemLinkMacros is an addon which allows you to add item links into your macros simply by Shift-LClicking an item link while the macro window is open.

entries.name: ItemRack
entries.description: Dieses AddOn erleichtert den Wechsel von Ausrüstung durch kontextuelle PopUps, extra Interface Buttons, definierbare Ausrüstungssets und automatischen Ausrüstungswechsel.

entries.name: ITPI
entries.description: Profession and Quest icons for tooltips, backported for Project Ascension 3.3.5a. (Original by Bytespire, Backport by Xurkon)

entries.name: JabberJab LevelJukebox
entries.description: JabberJab:LevelJukebox This addon plays a tune when you level up and when you die. Both of these features are able to be toggled on or off. It is also possible to play a tune on demand.

entries.name: JD's Fail Check
entries.description: This mod was created after a certain DK in my guild was complaining about the new Ready Check sound that came with 3.3. So, in honor of all the failness that is Johndoe, I present to you: JD's Fail Check, version 1.0. :p Note: If anyone read my previous note, I decided to update it....

entries.name: JebusMail
entries.description: JebusMail vereinfacht dir das Senden und Empfangen von Briefen.

entries.name: JF_ArdentAware
entries.description: Alerts party/raid members when a protection paladin (tankadin) has consumed Ardent Defender.

entries.name: Jobs'a'goodn
entries.description: Description After a hards day questin' this mod will give a little peon soundbite when you complete a quest or an objective.

entries.name: JTNinja
entries.description: This specific add-on is intended only for use on Jubei'Thos.

entries.name: KasoBubbles
entries.description: Originally written by Kaso of Horizons. Updated and optimised by me and Lonny.

entries.name: Key Bind Profiles
entries.description: This addon allows you to save keybind settings into different profiles, these profiles can be loaded and used again later. Each profile can be assigned to a specialization such that it automatically loads upon switching specs. Accessable through /kbp help

entries.name: KeyBinding Search
entries.description: A simple addon that lets you sort through all those dozens of key bindings to get to the ones you want quickly. Just open up your key binding frame and use the search and incremental selections at the bottom.

entries.name: KeyboardAccess
entries.description: Description KeyboardAccess enables you to use your Enter(Return) Key for accepting a general pop-up question ingame - or decline it with ESC.

entries.name: kgPanels
entries.description: Dieses AddOn bietet euch die Möglichkeit, die Buttons von anderen AddOns an einem Ort zu versammeln und per Klick zu öffnen. Das Aussehen und die Transparenz lassen sich individuell einstellen.

entries.name: Kharthus' Hunter Timer
entries.description: Dieses AddOn gibt dir ein zusätzliches Fenster, welches dir die Abkling- und Wirkungszeiten deiner Zauber anzeigt.

entries.name: KIbsItemLevel
entries.description: KIbsItemLevel for 3.3.5

entries.name: Kicker
entries.description: Kicker provides a method to specify to a person why they're being kicked from or why you quit a guild. It will send the reason in a whisper to the kicked person and broadcast it, or gquit reason, to the rest of the guild. If no reason is given, well, it gives it's own reason. :)

entries.name: Killing Blows Enhanced
entries.description: !!! DISCLAIMER - All credit goes to Macca for making the base for this addon !!!

entries.name: Killingblows
entries.description: This addon shows a message, and plays a sound, when you've made a killing blow. It cooperates with other players in party/raid/bg/arena that also got the addon, that means that they will also get a message and a sound when you make a killing blow.

entries.name: KillingSpree
entries.description: Consecutive killing blow announcer. :banana:

entries.name: kkIlls
entries.description: This searches and breaks bosskill-achievements down into a nifty little line in your tooltip.

entries.name: Konfer - Suicide Kings
entries.description: Helfer für das Suicide Kings Loot-System.

entries.name: KPack
entries.description: WoTLK collection of addons turned into modules inside a single addon.

entries.name: Krahg's Functions
entries.description: This add-on contains actions I do repeatatively but that are to complex for the in game macro system.

entries.name: kRogue
entries.description: Timer/Combo/Energy mod for rogues heavily based upon mRogue (http://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info9690-mRogue.html).

entries.name: KRT: Kader Raid Tools
entries.description: It was mainly made for raid leaders and it offers a lot of useful features to really make raid leading as easy as possible.

entries.name: KRU - Kader's Raid Utilities
entries.description: This addon was part of [KPack](https://github.com/bkader/KPack), it was extracted and made as a standalone addon after few requests, contains 8 very useful modules.

entries.name: KTracker
entries.description: WoTLK TellMeWhen Clone with more options.

entries.name: KuiNameplates-WoTLK
entries.description: Kui_Nameplates for WoTLK.

entries.name: Larger Macro Icon Selection
entries.description: Mit diesem AddOn kannst du dir die Größe deiner Makrosymbole bestimmen. Es wird allerdings nur geladen, wenn du vorher das Makrofenster via /makro aufgerufen hast.

entries.name: Lazy Raider
entries.description: This addon contains a couple of features to make your life easier as raid leader.

entries.name: LazyBoy
entries.description: Do you run heroics when you're bored, maybe when you need some Triumph badges, even for your daily or maybe for your alts who desperately sub-par gear? Regardless of the reason why you do heroics, they are a joke. No skill, no effort, just 15 minutes of your life.

entries.name: lazyscan
entries.description: Scan minimap for gaterhing nodes.

entries.name: LDB launcher for PortalBox
entries.description: An LDB launcher for PortalBox. Allows you to open/close the PortalBox screen and go to the config screen from any LDB addon that supports the launchers (for example TitanPanel).

entries.name: LDB Marker
entries.description: LDB Marker by Slashee the Cow Quite simple: adds LibDataBroker feeds for buttons to mark your current target. Just add the feeds to your LDB display addon, and click the icon for the mark you want. (Oh yes, you will need something to display LDB feeds).

entries.name: Leadem
entries.description: Leadem is a raid/party target management and assignment tool for raid/party leaders. They can assign actions (sap, sheep, etc.) to any target while also assigning icons automatically. The assignments can be announced to the raid/party easily. The interface provides dynamically resizing frames.

entries.name: Leatrix Maps
entries.description: Leatrix Maps enhances the world map with a movable borderless window, opacity controls, coordinates, zone and fishing levels, points of interest, quest objectives, map reveal, and configurable zoom and panning. Open its options with /ltm.

entries.name: Leatrix Plus
entries.description: Leatrix Plus provides a collection of optional quality-of-life improvements for quests, gossip, summons, resurrection, vendors, chat, frames, text, and other interface systems. Open its configuration with /ltp.

entries.name: LeaveParty
entries.description: Leave the raid or party with a simple slashcommand, just type /LP

entries.name: LFD Queue Timer
entries.description: This addon is for anyone like me who runs dailies while waiting for a random dungeon and wants to know whether they have time for one more.

entries.name: LFDAutoJoin
entries.description: LFDAutoJoin automatically joins ready LFDs. It's very lightweight and has little customization.

entries.name: LforLogout
entries.description: LforLogout /logout too many keys to press? Press only a few, /l, with LforLogout!

entries.name: LibCompat-1.0
entries.description: A utility library that provides extra useful functions to you addons, some were added in later expansions, others are useful for other things.

entries.name: LibUnitframe
entries.description: THIS IS ALPHA AND WILL KILL YOUR HAMSTERS!!! LibUnitframe has no functionality you need an addon that makes use of this library.

entries.name: LifeTapper
entries.description: Do you find yourself always forgetting to use Life Tap to be able to maintain Glyph of Life Tap buff? Not any longer as LifeTapper is here! It warns you when your buff is fading out or is not active at all.

entries.name: LifetapPoke
entries.description: Pokes you when you have a HoT and is low on mana and full on health, so you can lifetap.

entries.name: Linfo
entries.description: Latest version on Curse. Simple development tool which displays, on any hiperlink tooltip, the correspondent link string and icon texture source path.

entries.name: LittleWigs
entries.description: LittleWigs funktioniert genauso wie BigWigs, nur das dieses für 5-Mann-Instanzen gemacht wurde.

entries.name: Lockout
entries.description: Description: Simple mod that keeps track of locked out (interrupted) spellschools for your target and focus. It shows the Icon of the interrupted spell, as well as the remaining duration in seconds. Up to three spellschools can be displayed simultaneously for both the target and the focus.

entries.name: LookFor2
entries.description: Lets you know when an NPC, player, herb, tracked object, or anything else you are looking for is mouseovered, using text searches in the tooltips. Helpful when trying to find an elite mob, named quest mob, quest objects, herbs, ore, etc. in a crowd.

entries.name: Looking For More
entries.description: Looking For More tool to help build your raids. Specify your raid, and decide what you need: 2 tanks 3 healers 5 dps Optionally select specific classes for each role to fill. Announce your LFM to the usual lfg channels ( General, Trade-City, LookingForGroup).

entries.name: Lootificator
entries.description: A very simple addon to link all loot on a mob with a slash command.

entries.name: LoseControl
entries.description: LoseControl makes it easy to see the duration of crowd control spells by displaying them in a dedicated icon onscreen.

entries.name: LossofControl
entries.description: LossOfControl zeigt in einem neuen Interfaceelement gut sichtbar an, wenn der eigene Charakter von einschränkenden Effekten betroffen ist. (Stille, Betäubung, Entwaffnet, etc.) Verbleibende Dauer, Symbol und Name des Effektes werden angezeigt standardmäßig angezeigt und können nach eigenem Ermessen eingestellt werden.

entries.name: lowAvoidance
entries.description: LibDataBroker-based Critable display with Hit Table Project Page: http://lowlee.github.com/lowavoidance/

entries.name: Ludwig
entries.description:
Ludwig is an World of Warcraft item database addon that allows you to search for any item ingame.

It presents all ingame items sorted by their proprieties, and allows you to filter them as well.

entries.name: LUI v3
entries.description: LUI ersetzt das Standardinterface von Blizzard vollständig und bietet dir ein alternatives, anpassbares Interface im Gegenzug.

entries.name: Lunarblood
entries.description: Hello there! This is a very simple, single-frame support addon for Mutilate Rogues. It behaves like Feral by Night, Face Mauler and Face Melter, and others - it displays in your screen a suggestion for what should be your next move in order to optimize DPS.

entries.name: MacroBank
entries.description: MacroBank is an addon that allows you to easily create, organize, and save macros for future use without needing to first create them in the game's default macro window. It offers features like categorizing macros, editing text and icons, loading and replacing macros, and even sending macros to other MacroBank users.

entries.name: MacroHelp for ClassBuffs
entries.description: This addon shows you how to create macros that ca be used for all-in-one buffing for situations where you either don't need to use group buffs or can't use group buffs.

entries.name: MacroMe
entries.description: Quickly share macros with other players. This add-on is designed to allow the player to easily share a macro with a raid or party member.

entries.name: Mage Fever
entries.description: Mage Fever has been revamped. Trackers are completely dynamic now. Simply type in the id of the spell/buff/debuff you want to track and add it to the list. Each tracker is customizable in size, scale, and color. Icons can be shown for each as well.

entries.name: Mage Nuggets
entries.description: Mage Nuggets is a utility with many useful nuggets to make the lives of mages easier.

entries.name: MailTips
entries.description: MailTips zeigt als Tooltip, was einem Brief angehängt wurde.

entries.name: MakeBreak
entries.description: This is old and broken. Move along.

entries.name: Malarkey
entries.description: Description: This is my first AddOn and its concept is very simple, it automatically summons a random companion pet everytime you login or change zone, unless you happen to be mounted or stealthed. Perfect for pet collectionists!

entries.name: MalygosStaticAlarm
entries.description: Provides advanced warning of an incoming Static Field before it actually reaches the raid and begins inflicting damage.

entries.name: MapNotes
entries.description: Ist ein AddOn, mit dem man sich Notizen auf der Weltkarte anlegen kann.

entries.name: Mapster
entries.description: Mapster is a very simple world map enhacement addon, which was designed to work in conjunction with all other map addons out there.

entries.name: Mark-able Mail
entries.description: I have very little time to play WoW and even less time to code addons. As such I've dropped all development of all my addons. If you want to continue any addon or make a fork then feel free to do so. This is your permission slip.

entries.name: MarkBar INT
entries.description: 4.0.1 AlphaVersion available: [Click!] Description: This is an adjustable toolbar with raid target icon buttons; quicker and easier than the standard UI target popup menu.

entries.name: Masque-WoTLK
entries.description: Masque backported and compatible with WotLK.

entries.name: MassMailer
entries.description: Status of MassMailer in 4.01 As you may know, in the 4.01 patch, Blizzard instituted a number of throttling measures to chat channels (to prevent spamming).

entries.name: Math Quiz
entries.description: Math Quiz is a simple quiz addon that quizzes your friends with simple math questions. It also keeps track of everybody's score(named IQ) and you can display a ranking. It currently asks questions about adding numbers, substracting numbers and multiplying numbers.

entries.name: mBrokerPerl
entries.description: mBrokerPerl is a very simple LDB plugin for Perl Classic Unit Frames. May be used with any (i think) LDB display or with FuBar if combined with Broker2FuBar addon.

entries.name: Message Notice
entries.description: A simple in-game mail notifier that warns you when you have mail. :cool:

entries.name: MetaMap
entries.description: Neben Atlas hat sich MetaMap inzwischen zu DER Landkarten-Applikation für World of Warcraft gemausert. Und das ist kein Zufall, denn die Features dieses AddOns sind mächtig. Neben Standards wie vergrößerbaren Welt-, Stadt- und Instanzkarten könnt ihr euch mit MetaMap im Hintergrund im Spiel fortbewegen, bekommt Koordinaten, dürft beliebige Notizen in Karten einfügen und sogar ein Wegpunkte-System nutzen. Darüber hinaus wird auf Wunsch Beute von Bossen angezeigt. MetaMap harmoniert zudem mit Titan Bar und wird komfortabel über ein Mausmenü angesteuert.

entries.name: Meters
entries.description: Attempts to replace all references to yards (in tooltips) with meters. Effect is purely aesthetical, the game systems do not change at all.

entries.name: Method Raid Tools (MRT)
entries.description: Helpful addon for raiders, especially for raid leaders and officers. Modules: Raid Cooldowns, Notes, Reminders, Visual Notes, Battle Resurrection icon, Fight/combat log, Raid Inspect Viewer, Raid Check, Invite Tools, Timers, Raid Attendance, Encounters Statistics, Saving log (autologging), Marks Bar, Permanent Marks, Loot to chat, Who pulled, WeakAuras checker, Raid Groups Saver

entries.name: Metroid Upgrade
entries.description: Plays the Item Upgrade sound from Super Metroid when you receive an Epic item.

entries.name: MikScrollingBattleText(MSBT)
entries.description: MSBT is designed to be an extremely lightweight, efficient, and highly configurable mod that makes it easier to see combat information by scrolling the information on the screen in separate, dynamically creatable scroll areas. It is a replacement for Blizzard's Floating Combat Text and Damage output.

entries.name: Miller
entries.description: Miller is a small Addon that shows a list of all millable herbs in your inventory. You can click the icons to mill the herbs.

entries.name: MimironFFA
entries.description: Vashj all over again? - Say it ain't so! MimironFFA automatically switches to FFA loot for Mimiron phase 3 and back to whatever it was before afterwards so you can loot those cores without hassle.

entries.name: MinimapButtonFrame
entries.description: Collects minimap addon buttons and organizes them into a movable, customizable frame.

entries.name: MinimapButtonFrame (MBF)
entries.description: Dieses AddOn verschiebt all eure Minimapsymbole in einen Rahmen, welchen ihr dann selber an eurer Lieblingsstelle arrangieren könnt, sodass das Interface übersichtlicher bleibt.

entries.name: MinimapClick
entries.description: Simple Addon that enable so you can click on the minimap to toggle Tracking and Calendar.

entries.name: MisDirectionHelper2
entries.description: Complete rewrite of Misdriectionhelper. Now Uses Ace3 and has Full LDB support.

entries.name: MobInfo2
entries.description: Adds detailed mob stats (health, mana, drops) to tooltips and target frame

entries.name: MobMap
entries.description: Das AddOn MobMapist ist eine Art Ingame-Datenbankbrowser. Es zeigt dir die Positionen aller gespeicherter NPCs auf der Ingame-Karte und auf Wunsch auch auf der Minimap an. Es integriert sich außerdem ins Questlog und macht mit einem Klick die Position vieler Questmobs ausfindig. Darüber hinaus erschließt es dir die MobMap-Questdatenbank, die Händlerdatenbank und die Rezeptdatenbank.

entries.name: MogIt
entries.description: MogIt is an in-game catalogue of items with the aim of helping players build their own sets for transmogrification purposes.

entries.name: Mok Frames
entries.description: ==DELETE ANY OLD oUF_Mok FILES YOU HAVE== Newly rewritten. Layout is now proof of concept for an in-game layout designer for those that want to harness the power of oUF but don't have the coding skills to make their own. I will add features if requested. Author Portal now enabled.

entries.name: Molinari
entries.description: Molinari allows the player to easily "salvage" items directly from the inventory by holding down the Alt key and clicking on the item in their bags, instead of dealing with the tradeskill UI, spellbook, macros or actions.

entries.name: MonkeyToggler
entries.description: MonkeyToggler is a launcher for MonkeyQuest (2.x) implemented using LibDataBroker. It can also display the number of currently active quests.

entries.name: MoP Item Tooltips
entries.description: MoP Item Tooltips is an add-on to modifiy item tooltips so they look like they do in later expansions.

entries.name: MOTD_Guild_ONLOGIN
entries.description: Displays Guild Message Of The Day on login and change, also shows Your Guild Tabard next to the MOTD. No Config works out of the box. Changes Coming Make Frame movable Change Look of the frame with custom graphics add guild name display

entries.name: Mount Check
entries.description: Mount Check provides you with a comprehensive list of every mount and pet in the game. With the addon you can clearly see what Mounts and pets you have collected, and which you have yet to collect.

entries.name: MountBar
entries.description: MountBar is a relatively simple addon to help manage one’s mountain of mounts. Unlike other mount addons, this one does not have a hard coded list of mounts: instead, it learns the speed and properties of mounts as one summons them.

entries.name: Movable
entries.description: Movable allows you to move just about any frame. Bind a key to it (under keybindings), then press that key to make whatever is under your mouse movable. Note that some frames may not react to this as you'd expect.

entries.name: MoveAnything
entries.description: MoveAnything enables you to move, scale, hide and adjust transparency of just about any screen element in WoW, offering tools to help you customize your UI.

entries.name: MoveTooltip
entries.description: MoveTooltip allows you to move the default tooltip. It is operated by a sole slash command /movett which controls the points by which you can anchor the tooltip.

entries.name: MoveTracker
entries.description: Old and broken. Move along.

entries.name: murloc!

entries.description: Ever wanted to know how many times you have entered 5-man heroics with all of your characters? Or how many quest you have ever done in total over all of your characters?

entries.description: TotemFunctions contains 3 new slash commands for assigning totem spells to the various "Call of" spells. The intent is that the user can easily create macros to set up standard sets of totems for various activites. For instance, 3 macros might be set up for PvP, solo PvE, and group PvE.

entries.description: This lets you quickly look up statistics from the Armory about any character, including average item level, achievements, and dungeon clears on TrackWarcraft.com. You can instantly look up every character in /who, your party, or raid at once!

entries.name: Trav's Unit Frame Extensions
entries.description: Tired of hovering over your target or your party members to see what their class is? Well, Trav's Unit Frame Extensions adds class icons to the Blizzard Unit Frames so you can see their class at a glance!

entries.name: Tremor Tracker
entries.description: Tremor Tracker shows a warning on your screen when your tremor totem is dead when you are in an arena. It also puts a warning to party chat whenever a spell is cast that could be broken by tremor, but can't because tremor is dead.

entries.name: Tricks Helper
entries.description: Intelligently creates and self modifies a Tricks of the Trade macro for easy control of your Tricks of the Trade ability.

entries.name: TrinketCDs

entries.description: TrufiGCD a small addon, that shows the last used abilities of party or arena members. Can be also used for streaming to show the lastest used Spell used from you.

entries.name: TukUI
entries.description: TukUI ist geeignet für Freunde des Minimalismuses. Es vereinfacht Blizzards Interface und bricht es auf die Funktionen alleine herunter.

entries.name: TurnIn
entries.description:
An add-on that automates the clicking of Quests and NPC Gossip dialogues. Automatically turns in repeatable or regular quests, accepts quests, and selects the appropriate options from NPCs. Never have to talk to an NPC again!

To bring up the Options window, type **/ti window**.

entries.name: tuttiHUD
entries.description: This is a very minimalistic HUD. You get a health and resource bar for yourself, your pet, your target and focus, and their targets. Druids also get a mana bar in cat or bear form, and death knights get rune cooldown bars. You can also create your own custom bars, to track most anything.

entries.name: TweakWoW
entries.description: Das AddOn TweakWoW erweitert die Einstellungen in WoW um eine Vielzahl an Optionen, die sonst nur durch das Editieren der config.wtf erreichbar sind. Über einen neuen Eintrag im Blizzard Interfacemenü könnt Ihr spielend einfach Dinge wie die Screenshotqualität, grünes Blut oder die Anzahl der Bodentexturen verändern.

entries.name: TwentyFive-Remake
entries.description: Updated 12th March 2010 There is a known issue where the AddOn throws a concatenation error - I believe this is caused by having a target at the time you accept a Summon, enter a BG / Random Heroic, etc, and should hopefully be fixed in the next version.

entries.name: UberQuest
entries.description: UberQuest UberQuest is a drop-in replacement for Blizzard's QuestLog providing a dual pane view, full panes for the quest listing and a second full pane for the quest description itself. Plus, my favorite feature, a powerful quest tracker/minion.

entries.name: Ultimate Warcraft Battlecry Generator
entries.description: Note: This addon is now updated for 3.3! This addon can generate over 100 hilarious and random warcraft related battlecries to put fear into your enemies, and to inspire courage in your allies.

entries.name: Unified Profile Manager
entries.description:
Manage all your AceDB-based addon profiles from one single interface.
Open it with /profiles or /upm to view, switch, copy, and clean up profiles across addons and characters, all in one compact list.

entries.description: I have very little time to play WoW and even less time to code addons. As such I've dropped all development of all my addons. If you want to continue any addon or make a fork then feel free to do so. This is your permission slip.

entries.name: Vd-skip
entries.description: Vd-skip is a lightweight addon that streamlines NPC interactions by automatically skipping unnecessary dialogue with vendors and flight masters.

entries.name: VirtualPing (AVR)
entries.description: VirtualPing is a simple, configuration-free add-on that places Minimap pings on the actual 3D plane, using AVR (by Olog). AVR fascinates me, and this was a simple experiment after messing with AVR for a bit. There are much greater things to come from AVR though.

entries.name: VisualAFK
entries.description: VisualAFK is a small utility which turns on the name over your own character when you are AFK, and turns it off when you are not.

entries.name: VuhDo
entries.description: VuhDo is a raid monitor built-in raid frames. Basically this is about displaying the health of raid members in form of clearly arranged bars.

entries.name: waStats
entries.description: This is my addon to monitor FPS and Latency, a lot of credits goes to Lyn and Gotai for helping me out. :) There is a very small config at the top of the .lua file to toggle locked/unlocked.

entries.name: Watcher
entries.description: Watcher ist ein praktisches Rotationshilfetool. Es zeigt Jägern, Kriegern, Paladinen, Druiden und Schattenpriestern die nächste Fähigkeit an, die du benutzen solltest, um größtmöglichen Schaden zu verursachen.

entries.name: WeakAuras
entries.description: WeakAuras is a powerful and flexible framework that allows the display of highly customizable graphics on World of Warcraft's user interface to indicate buffs, debuffs, and other relevant information. This addon was created to be a lightweight replacement for Power Auras but has since introduced more functionalities while remaining efficient and easy to use.

entries.name: WeakAuras
entries.description: Displays configurable graphics and text based on buffs, debuffs, cooldowns, and other triggers

entries.name: WeakAuras
entries.description: Ein leistungsfähiges, umfassendes Addon zur grafischen Darstellung von Informationen von Auren, Cooldowns, Timern und vielem mehr.

entries.name: WgClock - Wintergrasp Start Time Notifications
entries.description: At 60, 30, 15, 10, 5, 3, and 1 minute(s) you will be notified a Wintergrasp PvP is about to start. The notification is an "alert message"; with the same message appearing in the chat window. See Screen-shot (the screenshot was forced at 78 minutes, you will NOT see an alert at 78 minutes).

entries.name: What's Training?
entries.description: What's Training? adds a new spellbook tab that lists every trainable spell for your class. Spells are grouped into categories such as available now, missing requirements, coming soon, and not yet available, with the required level and total training cost shown at a glance.

entries.name: WhereToNow
entries.description: WhereToNow zeigt dir, welches Gebiet für dich als nächstes am besten geeignet zum Leveln ist und welche Instanzen sich in deinem Levelbereich befinden. Zusätzlich wird dir angezeigt, was die maximale Stufe des Gebietes wäre. Dieses AddOn befindet sich als Minibar an deiner Map und zeigt dir die Informationen via Mouseover.

entries.name: WildIgnore
entries.description: This very simple addon will allow you to use the "/ignore %t" command to ignore your current target without having to try to figure out how to type all those special characters that most players use in their name.

entries.name: WildList
entries.description: WildList allow you to add a note to a player and it will be said in party chat when you team with them. Because the ignore list is limited to 50 and that the /lfd will only use the real ignore list, I could not just put every frozen orb ninja-looter or bad player on my list.

entries.name: WildMount
entries.description: This addon will allow you to mount with a random mount. Unlike most other addons of this kind, this one is dynamic. It doesnt check via a set list of mounts, so no need to update it every time Blizzard add a new mount ingame.

entries.name: WIM (WoW Instant Messenger)
entries.description: WIM (WoW Instant Messenger) is a World of Warcraft addon which brings an instant messenger feel to communication in game.

entries.name: Windchime
entries.description: Windchime is a bar mod for Shamans that displays your Windfury Weapon buff internal 3 second cooldown.

entries.name: WintergraspLDB
entries.description: A very simple addon that makes the Wintergrasp timer available to the LDB system.

entries.name: WintergraspLite
entries.description: WintergraspLite WintergraspLite is a very small, very light-weight addon which provides much more convenient access to the Wintergrasp timer.

entries.name: WinterRepBC
entries.description: This is a working fan update from the original WinterRep addon created by Thrissa of Eminence Guild on the Blackrock realm. I have added functionality to track all 3 avaible quests, and reworked the display. If you have any questions please feel free to send me an IN GAME email or tell ..

entries.name: Worgenius
entries.description: Before Gilneas succumbed to an unspeakable curse, an erudite scholar traveled Azeroth, offering sage advice to those who would listen. After years spent in isolation, he now yearns to see what changes the years and the Cataclysm have wrought upon the world.

entries.name: World BG timer.
entries.description: World BG timer is a simple and lightweight addon that will post how many minutes until the next Winter Grasp battle and post the status of the different elements in the Battlegrounds.

entries.name: WoW ReloadUI
entries.description: I needed a simple way to reload the user interface and couldn't find one that simply placed a button on the screen! So I decided to make my own! It is ideal for testing interface changes that require regular reloads of the interface.

entries.name: WoWQuote2

entries.name: wRuneDisplay

entries.name: X-Perl

entries.name: XBar
entries.description: Mit XBar erstellt Ihr eigene Aktionsleisten. Über den /-Befehl gelangt Ihr in ein simples Konfigurationsmenü. Dort lassen sich Leisten nach belieben erstellen und konfigurieren. Verschiedene vorgefertigte Bars wie beispielsweise Magierportale, Siegel oder Totemleisten stehen bereits zur Verfügung.

entries.name: xCT+
entries.description:
xCT+ is a combat text replacement (like MSBT).
Backported from retail Pandaria, this version compared to other backports offers control over settings in-game and is more minimalistic and anti-spammy than MSBT

entries.name: XLoot

entries.name: XqoNTK
entries.description: XqoNTK helps you manage damage-modifiers (Culling the Herd, T10 (2)-setbonus etc) with Serpent Sting, and warns you when you should reapply Serpent Sting by showing you the difference between the active modifiers from when Serpent Sting was fired and your current modifers.

entries.name: YawningCombat
entries.description: A rewrite of CombatTimer. Displays a timer bar showing how long it will be till a player exits PvP combat. This is primarily aimed at stealth classes and for heal drinking. Since it is useless in PvE, by default it will only be enabled in Arenas and Battlegrounds.

entries.name: yhfb - Hunger For Blood tracker

entries.name: YKTarget

entries.name: You Got Mail
entries.description: When you have mail, it plays the classic AOL "You Got Mail" sound. This will remind you every time there's a loading screen, as well as when you log in.

entries.name: yQuestLevel
entries.description: The addon does *ONE* thing: Show you the quest level in the quest log frame.

entries.description: A durability plugin for LDB.

entries.name: ZodProc

entries.name: ZoneLevelInfo
entries.description: Zeigt Levelbereiche sowie Schwierigkeitsgerade aller Zonen auf der Weltkarte an.

entries.name: zStats
entries.description: zStats v0.9 zStats is a small, ace-free SLDataText replacement. I know there are already a lot of these mods with "insert random letter here"Stats name out there, but I thought this would be a good project to start with addon/lua programming :>

entries.name: Zygor Guides
entries.description:
Zygor Guides Viewer Remaster is a modernized version of the classic Zygor Guides Viewer, built specifically for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King (3.3.5a / build 12340) private servers.
It preserves the original 3.3.5a guide engine, step system, and waypoint workflow while introducing a cleaner, retail-inspired UI, an improved Guide Manager, updated arrow and objective styling, accessibility options (including colorblind presets), and ongoing compatibility support for WotLK 3.3.5a environments.
The addon includes step-by-step leveling guidance, waypoint navigation, structured quest flow, and an integrated Talent Advisor - all packaged in a remastered, streamlined viewer designed for long play sessions.
